SELECT SM.COMPANY_CODE AS companyCode ,SM.DIVISION_CODE AS divisionCode ,SM.SALES_NO AS salesNo FROM SALES_MST SM WHERE SM.COMPANY_CODE = #{p.companyCode} AND SM.INVOICE_DATE LIKE #{p.yyyymmdd} || '%' AND SM.EXPORT_FLAG = 'E' AND SM.TARGET_FTA_CODE IS NOT NULL AND SM.DIVISION_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.divisionCode}, SM.DIVISION_CODE) AND SM.CUSTOMER_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.customerCode}, SM.CUSTOMER_CODE) AND SM.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE = COALESCE(#{p.deliveryCustomerCode}, SM.DELIVERY_CUSTOMER_CODE)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SALES_DTL SD WHERE SD.SALES_NO = SM.SALES_NO AND SD.DIVISION_CODE = SM.DIVISION_CODE AND SD.COMPANY_CODE = SM.COMPANY_CODE AND SD.PRODUCT_CODE IN
#{productCode} )
ORDER BY SM.DIVISION_CODE, SM.CUSTOMER_CODE
